textos.Lançado em 2000 e dirigido por Christoph: Released in 2000 and directed by Christopher Nolan, Memento is a mystery thriller focused on the trajectory of Leonard, a man determined to find his wife's killer. The protagonist faces the challenge of living with an intractable form of short-term memory loss, being unable to remember events that happened fifteen minutes earlier.
textos.O filme adota uma atmosfera de mistério: The film adopts an atmosphere of mystery supported by a nonlinear, reverse time structure. The editing fragments the progression of events, demanding attention to follow the succession of events and the main character's disorientation.
textos.Os diferentes grupos de avaliação aborda: The different evaluation groups address essentially the same characteristics of the work, diverging on the verdict on how well this approach works. Among the vast majority of ratings (~89%), the nonlinear narrative structure is celebrated by about half of the analyses for providing a direct dive into the protagonist's condition. At the same time, a significant share praises the complexity of the script and the construction of the twists, while a portion highlight Guy Pearce's performance.
textos.Em contrapartida, para os espectadores s: In contrast, for the viewers in a minimal fraction of the ratings (~9%), most acknowledge the premise of the reverse editing, but a considerable number report confusion and difficulty understanding during the viewing, while many consider the ending disappointing given the expectation created. Lastly, in the perspective gathered in an even smaller fraction of the ratings (~2%), a good portion point to great difficulty following the plot, several criticize the slow pace and the sense of boredom generated by the experience, and a considerable number reject the nonlinear structure and editing as sounding like a tiring device.
